pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with sharp edge gradients. Geometry varies from small, dense shapes on the lower neck to larger, elongated quadrilaterals and pentagons on the upper flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous grid of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes are clearly defined where 3 to 4 patches converge. Pixel thickness of the corridors remains relatively uniform across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude bristled silhouette along the upper neck mane, becoming less distinct as it approaches the shoulder blades.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible vertical linear indentation on the mid-flank region. Distinct horizontal skin folds and creases are present at the base of the neck and chest junction.
